sql:
SELECT
  tss.tss_rank AS rank,
  tm.team_name AS team,
  tss.tss_points AS points
FROM team_season_standings AS tss
JOIN teams AS tm
  ON tm.team_id = tss.team_id
WHERE tss.tss_season = '2022-2023'
ORDER BY tss.tss_rank;
